verdict.rationale: Stable provides AI-generated document summaries and AI-powered auto-routing/sorting of mail based on content, which counts as AI-generated insights from user data. However, this is limited to mail summarization/routing rather than broader analytics, trend insights, or proactive suggestions across the business data, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of quality. Missing for 10: evidence of broader AI insights beyond mail summaries (e.g., analytics, proactive suggestions across companies/locations), and independent verification of summary accuracy.
